srs: The course enrollment system records Student, Enrollment, EnrollmentService, and Course; each has an id attribute. Each Student can have zero or more Enrollment records, and each Enrollment belongs to exactly one Student. Each Enrollment uses exactly one EnrollmentService, and each EnrollmentService serves zero or more Enrollment records. Each EnrollmentService manages one or more Course records by composition, and each Course belongs to exactly one EnrollmentService. Each Student can reference zero or more Course records, and each Course can be referenced by zero or more Student records.
